title: Same load, different pressure
hook: Which footprint gives lower average pressure?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Average pressure is force divided by contact area. Spreading the same load over more area lowers this calculated average; it does not reduce the total weight carried by the table.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.
